March 16, 2026, Awaysis Belize Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Awaysis Capital, Inc. (the “Company”), entered into
a construction loan agreement with The Belize Bank Limited providing financing of BZ$ 4,103,000 (approximately US$ 2,051,500 ),
including financing for construction and renovation expenditures and associated loan and closing costs. The proceeds are intended to finance the completion and development
of 12
condominium units at the Company’s Casamora property in San Pedro, Ambergris Caye, Belize.
The loan bears interest at the bank’s prime lending rate less 0.50%, initially equivalent to 8.0% per annum, subject
to adjustment in accordance with the loan agreement. The agreement provides for an initial six-month interest-only period, followed by
114 consecutive monthly installments of principal and interest. The contractual maturity date is September 30, 2036, unless otherwise
amended by the parties. Additionally, 50% of the proceeds from condominium sales are required to be applied toward accelerated principal
repayment.
Collateral and Guarantees
The construction loan is secured by real estate and related security arrangements involving properties located in
San Pedro, Belize. Under Schedule C of the financing agreement, the security arrangements include:
A registered charge over Parcels 576 and 577, Block 7, San Pedro Registration Section, in the name of Awaysis Belize
Limited, securing BZ$ 4,103,000 .
Lodgment of title documents by Yacht Club Resorts Development Company Limited for Strata Parcels 5513 H2, H3, H5,
H7, H8, H9, H12, H13, H14 and H15, Block 7, San Pedro Registration Section.
Additional lodgment requirements for Strata Parcels 5513 H4 and H6, Block 7, San Pedro Registration Section, subject
to the availability of the respective titles.
Assignment of rental proceeds from charged properties and applicable insurance coverage naming The Belize Bank Limited
as an interested party.
The loan agreement also provides for a corporate guarantee by Yacht Club Resorts Development Company Limited and
personal guarantees by Michael Singh and Andrew Trumbach.
The financing agreement contains customary lending provisions and other conditions, including reporting requirements,
insurance obligations, collateral requirements, and restrictions and repayment provisions relating to condominium sales.
